entities.summary: Jean-Pierre Le Roux is a French chess player. He was awarded a grandmaster title in 2010, an International master in 2004 and a FIDE master in 2003 from FIDE. He is ranked 16th in France. He won the 43rd Guernsey International Chess Festival in 2017 and the French rapid chess championship in 2018.
